identity_audit.source_strain_link: Study Methods: all mutant strains derivatives of OG1RF; NCBI AEA94342.1 explicitly strain OG1RF/ATCC47077 and locus OG1RF_11655.
identity_audit.official_record_link: UniProt OG1RF A0ACD6TD29 cross-references GenBank AEA94342.1 / CP002621 and RefSeq WP_002356987.1 / NC_017316.1; downloaded GenBank protein sequence equals UniProt sequence exactly.
identity_audit.experimental_identity_link: Three reported OG1RF RlmN targeted-proteomics peptide sequences match retrieved native sequence exactly.
identity_audit.position_limitation: All three paper position pairs are one less than conventional 1-based sequence coordinates, consistent with zero-based index reporting; this is a coordinate-convention inference, not silently corrected primary text.
identity_audit.duplication: V583 UniProt Q833B6 / EF_2048 is identical over all 357 residues, and shares WP_002356987.1. Count only one unique sequence; tie direct deletion evidence to OG1RF.
identity_audit.published_5prime_link: The gene-specific start of published Supplementary Table 6 overexpression forward oligo exactly matches the start of independently retrieved native CP002621.1 CDS at the NCBI coded_by interval; native sequence only retained.

experimental_limitations: Experimental attribution is native-gene deletion with nucleoside mass spectrometry, not isolated-enzyme biochemical reconstitution.
The paper measured m2A in bulk purified RNA species; precise A2503/A37 site assignments use established RlmN biology rather than de novo site-resolved mapping in this study.
The natural alternative-family label does not mean safety, universal antibiotic susceptibility, or absence of context-dependent phenotypic effects.
NCBI legacy product wording says cfr family radical SAM enzyme; it must not be used as functional ground truth against the direct OG1RF experimental evidence.
This newly inspected comparator is development-panel material, not an untouched independent test example.
Source/identity audit performed computationally; it is not an independent expert validation of assay quality.
